sql: SELECT x.region, x.customer_id, x.customer_name, x.total_omset, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT r.region AS region, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.peringkat <= 3 ORDER BY x.region, x.peringkat

question: Sales mana yang lebih dari separuh deal won-nya berasal dari pelanggan di wilayah yang berbeda dengan wilayah sales itu?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, r.region, round(countIf(c.attributes['region'] != r.region) / count(), 2) AS rasio_beda_wilayah FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.region HAVING countIf(c.attributes['region'] != r.region) / count() > 0.5 ORDER BY rasio_beda_wilayah DESC

question: Hitung rata-rata lama closing (hari dari dibuat sampai closed) deal won per tim sales dan segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT r.team, c.segment, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, c.segment ORDER BY rata_rata_hari_closing

question: Tampilkan pelanggan Enterprise yang omsetnya di atas 500 ribu dan punya lebih dari 3 tiket high atau urgent, lengkap dengan omset dan jumlah tiketnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, o.total_omset, k.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent') GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND o.total_omset > 500000 AND k.jumlah_tiket > 3

question: Sales siapa saja yang beraktivitas dalam 30 hari terakhir tapi belum punya deal won dengan pelanggan Enterprise bulan ini?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) AND r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: Tampilkan running total omset bulanan per tim sales tahun ini untuk pelanggan Enterprise.
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date)) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, bulan ORDER BY r.team, bulan

question: Per segmen dan tim sales, tampilkan win rate dan total omset, hanya untuk kombinasi yang punya minimal 20 deal closed.
sql: SELECT c.segment, r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.segment, r.team HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 20 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: list customer yg dihubungi lebih dari 3 sales berbeda, tampilin jumlah sales sama jumlah tim yg terlibat
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales, uniqExact(r.team) AS jumlah_tim FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING jumlah_sales > 3

question: Sales mana yang omset dari pelanggan bertag high-value-nya melebihi rata-rata omset high-value semua sales?
sql: WITH per_sales AS (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(c.tags, 'high-value') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name) SELECT p.rep_id, p.rep_name, p.total_omset FROM per_sales AS p WHERE p.total_omset > (SELECT avg(q.total_omset) FROM per_sales AS q) ORDER BY p.total_omset DESC

question: Per wilayah sales, bandingkan jumlah deal won dengan jumlah demo ke pelanggan Enterprise, plus rasionya.
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(w.jumlah_won) AS jumlah_won, sum(x.jumlah_demo) AS jumlah_demo, round(sum(w.jumlah_won) / sum(x.jumlah_demo), 2) AS rasio_won_per_demo FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS w ON r.rep_id = w.rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS x ON r.rep_id = x.rep_id GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY rasio_won_per_demo DESC

question: Untuk setiap pelanggan tier Gold, siapa sales yang paling sering berinteraksi dengannya?
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.customer_name, x.rep_id, x.rep_name, x.jumlah_aktivitas FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Tim sales mana yang pelanggannya (lewat deal) punya rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket paling lama?
sql: SELECT p.team, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id, r.team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id) AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY p.team ORDER BY rata_rata_resolusi DESC LIMIT 1

question: Tampilkan semua sales beserta jumlah deal won dari pelanggan Enterprise, termasuk sales yang jumlahnya nol.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS jumlah_won_enterprise FROM sales_reps AS r LEFT JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON r.rep_id = d.rep_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region

question: Sales mana yang punya deal won dengan pelanggan yang juga pernah memberi sentimen negatif ke sales yang sama?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN activities AS a ON d.customer_id = a.customer_id AND d.rep_id = a.rep_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND a.sentiment = 'negative'

question: Per segmen, bandingkan rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket antara pelanggan yang punya deal won dan yang tidak.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, w.customer_id != ''), 2) AS rata_resolusi_punya_won, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, w.customer_id = ''), 2) AS rata_resolusi_tanpa_won FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS w ON t.customer_id = w.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket per segmen, khusus pelanggan yang punya deal dengan tim Account-Management.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Account-Management') AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rata_rata_resolusi DESC

question: Tampilkan sales yang belum menutup deal won dengan pelanggan Enterprise di kuartal ini.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()))

question: Per tim sales, hitung share omset masing-masing segmen pelanggan terhadap total omset tim tersebut tahun ini (dalam persen).
sql: SELECT r.team, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS persen_share FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, c.segment ORDER BY r.team, persen_share DESC

question: Tampilkan 5 perusahaan pelanggan dengan omset terbesar yang juga masih punya tiket terbuka, sertakan jumlah tiket terbukanya.
sql: SELECT c.company, sum(o.total_omset) AS total_omset, sum(k.jumlah_tiket_terbuka) AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id GROUP BY c.company ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: Per tim sales, berapa rata-rata jumlah aktivitas per deal won untuk pelanggan SMB?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(sum(x.jumlah_aktivitas) / count(), 2) AS rata_aktivitas_per_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id, a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.rep_id) AS x ON d.customer_id = x.customer_id AND d.rep_id = x.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rata_aktivitas_per_deal DESC

question: Bandingkan omset bulan ini vs bulan lalu per wilayah sales untuk pelanggan Enterprise.
sql: SELECT r.region, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY r.region

question: Sales mana yang deal pipeline-nya paling banyak tertahan di pelanggan yang sentimen aktivitas terakhirnya negatif?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id, argMax(a.sentiment, a.timestamp) AS sentimen_terakhir FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND s.sentimen_terakhir = 'negative' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 1

question: Hitung win rate per wilayah sales untuk deal yang di-close kuartal ini, pisahkan pelanggan yang wilayahnya sama dan berbeda dengan sales.
sql: SELECT r.region, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] = r.region) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND c.attributes['region'] = r.region), 2) AS win_rate_wilayah_sama, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] != r.region) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND c.attributes['region'] != r.region), 2) AS win_rate_wilayah_beda FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY r.region

question: Per produk, tampilkan omset tahun ini dan jumlah sales berbeda yang menjualnya ke pelanggan Enterprise.
sql: SELECT produk, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY produk ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang ditangani lewat deal oleh lebih dari satu tim sales, dan apa saja timnya?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, groupUniqArray(r.team) AS daftar_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING uniqExact(r.team) > 1 ORDER BY length(daftar_tim) DESC

question: Tampilkan per bulan tahun ini: jumlah pelanggan baru, jumlah deal won dari pelanggan baru itu, dan nilai omsetnya, khusus deal dari sales Inbound.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan_baru, countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND r.team = 'Inbound') AS jumlah_won_inbound, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND r.team = 'Inbound') AS omset_inbound FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Siapa 5 sales dengan total durasi aktivitas terbanyak ke pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent') AS ut ON a.customer_id = ut.customer_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_durasi DESC LIMIT 5

question: Per tim, urutkan pelanggan Mid-Market berdasarkan nilai pipeline dan tampilkan hanya peringkat 1 sampai 3.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.customer_id, x.customer_name, x.nilai_pipeline, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, sum(d.value) AS nilai_pipeline, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.segment = 'Mid-Market' GROUP BY r.team, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.peringkat <= 3 ORDER BY x.team, x.peringkat

question: Hitung rasio tiket urgent terhadap total tiket per wilayah sales, berdasarkan sales yang punya deal dengan pelanggan pemilik tiket.
sql: SELECT p.region, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id, r.region FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id) AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC

question: Sales mana yang punya deal won dari pelanggan Gold tapi tidak pernah melakukan demo ke pelanggan tersebut?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND (d.customer_id, d.rep_id) NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id, a.rep_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')

question: Untuk tiap sales, tampilkan selisih omset tahun ini dibanding rata-rata omset tahun ini di timnya, khusus pelanggan aktif.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(sum(d.value) - avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.status = 'active' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, selisih_dari_rata_tim DESC

question: Pelanggan yang total nilai deal pipeline-nya di atas 1 juta tapi tidak ada aktivitas dalam 30 hari terakhir: tampilkan id, nama, daftar nama sales yang menangani (satu baris per pelanggan), dan total nilai pipeline-nya, urutkan dari pipeline terbesar.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales, sum(d.value) AS nilai_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30)) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING nilai_pipeline > 1000000 ORDER BY nilai_pipeline DESC

question: Rekap per tim sales: jumlah deal won, rata-rata nilai deal won, dan jumlah tiket terbuka dari pelanggan deal-deal tersebut.
sql: SELECT w.team, w.jumlah_won, w.rata_rata_nilai, k.jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM (SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_won, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team) AS w LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.team, uniqExact(t.ticket_id) AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON t.customer_id = d.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY r.team) AS k ON w.team = k.team ORDER BY w.jumlah_won DESC

question: Per sales, persentase aktivitas positif ke pelanggan yang akhirnya punya deal won dengan sales itu.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') / count(), 2) AS persen_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id, d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS wd ON a.customer_id = wd.customer_id AND a.rep_id = wd.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY persen_positif DESC

question: Tampilkan wilayah pelanggan dengan jumlah pelanggan churn, total nilai deal lost mereka, dan jumlah tiket mereka.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah_pelanggan, count() AS jumlah_churn, sum(o.nilai_lost) AS total_nilai_lost, sum(k.jumlah_tiket) AS jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY wilayah_pelanggan ORDER BY jumlah_churn DESC

question: Rekap mingguan 30 hari terakhir: jumlah aktivitas dan jumlah pelanggan unik per tim sales untuk segmen Enterprise, plus rata-rata durasinya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY minggu, r.team ORDER BY minggu, r.team

question: Siapa sales dengan win rate tertinggi di masing-masing wilayah untuk pelanggan bertag tech?
sql: SELECT x.region, x.rep_id, x.rep_name, x.win_rate FROM (SELECT r.region AS region, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE has(c.tags, 'tech') GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.region

question: Tampilkan sales yang total weighted pipeline-nya dari pelanggan Enterprise lebih besar daripada omset Enterprise tahun ini miliknya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS weighted_pipeline, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region HAVING weighted_pipeline > omset_ytd

question: Per tier pelanggan, berapa rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan untuk pelanggan yang punya deal dengan sales LATAM?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(countIf(t.ticket_id != '') / uniqExact(c.customer_id), 2) AS rata_tiket_per_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.region = 'LATAM') AS p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY tier ORDER BY rata_tiket_per_pelanggan DESC
